events.name: Chicago White Sox at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Troy Melton allowed one hit in six innings and the Detroit Tigers' offense came alive late in a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Troy Melton allows one hit in six innings, Tigers beat White Sox 4-1

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart tied a career high with six RBI and the Cincinnati Reds pulled away for a 10-2 rout of the New York Yankees on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sal Stewart ties career high with six RBIs and Reds rout Yankees 10-2

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto hit a three-run home run to cap a five-run eighth inning and the Toronto Blue Jays rallied from a five-run deficit to beat the Chicago Cubs 8-6 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Okamoto hits a 3-run homer as the Blue Jays rally past the Cubs 8-6

events.name: San Diego Padres at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Manny Machado hit a three-run homer, his 13th this season, in the 10th inning and tied his season high of five RBI, helping the San Diego Padres rally for a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manny Machado hits a 3-run homer in 10th and has 5 RBIs as Padres beat Rangers 6-4

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies hit two homers, including a walk-off, two-run blast in the ninth inning to give the Atlanta Braves a 4-3 come-from-behind win over the Milwaukee Brewers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ozzie Albies hits 2 homers, including walk-off shot in 9th, to lift Braves past Brewers 4-3

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Max Meyer allowed two runs in five innings to win his eighth consecutive decision to start the season, Heriberto Hernández homered and the Miami Marlins beat the San Francisco Giants 6-3 on Saturday for their seventh straight victory at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Meyer wins 8th straight decision to start season as Marlins beat Giants 6-3

events.name: Washington Nationals at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Washington Nationals center fielder Jacob Young left Saturday’s game against the Tampa Bay Rays in the eighth inning after crashing into the outfield wall.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals' Jacob Young leaves game after crashing into outfield wall

events.name: New York Mets at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber homered three times, including twice in Philadelphia's eight-run third inning, and Bryce Harper hit for the cycle as the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Schwarber hits 3 homers, Bryce Harper hits for the cycle in Phillies’ 15-3 rout of Mets

headlines.description: — Rookie Travis Bazzana set career highs with four hits, two homers, five RBI and three runs scored Saturday night, and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Houston Astros 8-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Travis Bazzana’s career night leads Guardians to 8-1 win over Astros

headlines.description: — Jake McCarthy hit a leadoff inside-the-park home run off Paul Skenes and the Colorado Rockies survived another tense ninth inning to beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCarthy hits leadoff inside-the-park homer off Skenes in Rockies' 2-1 win over Pirates

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Walbert Ureña and three relievers combined on a five-hitter and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Athletics 7-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ureña and 3 Angels relievers silence Athletics in a 7-0 victory

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Wilyer Abreu hit a two-run homer, Connelly Early gave up two hits and a run in six innings and the Boston Red Sox beat the Seattle Mariners 5-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilyer Abreu, Connelly Early lead the Red Sox past the Mariners, 5-1

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Trevor Rogers allowed one hit over a dominating seven scoreless innings and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orioles beat Dodgers 3-2 behind Trevor Rogers' 7 scoreless innings

headlines.description: — Byron Buxton hit a grand slam in a 10-run fifth inning and the Minnesota Twins clobbered the Arizona Diamondbacks 16-8 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buxton hits grand slam in 10-run inning, Twins rout Diamondbacks 16-8
